conditions: Within the stated model of each source. The Picard realization verifies the operator hypotheses for each nontrivial generic Picard fibre; the vertical-lifting hypotheses hold for each original positive-relative-dimensional klt case.

roles.RMKC-PROJECTED-OPERATOR-DOMAIN: Constructs the rational polyhedral chamber on p(C) with whole-translate separation even where the operator ranks drop.
roles.RMKC-VERTICAL-KERNEL-LIFT: Uses finite vertical kernel, effective polyhedral intersections and finite refinement to transfer the chamber to all of Γ on C.
roles.RMKC-GENERIC-PICARD-REALIZATION: Realizes p(C) on the generic Picard group, descends the complex surface covering by a finite Albanese marking and the Siegel property, verifies the full translation lattice and real boundary fibres, and gives the elementary exceptional cases.
roles.RMKC-STRONG-REL2-THEOREM: Combines the three assertions to give a single strong rational polyhedral domain for each original fibre space.

explanation: For positive relative dimension and U nonzero apply the operator theorem to the cone and the entire group realized by the geometric source. When U=0 the realized base chamber suffices. In the klt cases apply the vertical lifting theorem to the resulting chamber. For relative dimension zero apply lifting to p(C)=0, and for the absolute dimensions zero or one use the explicitly classified degree or zero space.
scope: All objects and all boundary and degeneracy cases of the original statement.
whole_result: The three premises jointly give Π⊂C, ΓΠ=C, γΠ∩Int Π=∅ for each γ≠1, and trivial setwise stabilizer, for every original target fibration.
